P2_budget_vs_gpu_busy._claim: the budget must not bind artificially (D102)
P2_budget_vs_gpu_busy.diagnosis: the THIRD TERM is the problem and it is a double count. per_queue * queued_ahead is the LATENCY this request SUFFERS because other requests' work is in front of it, not GPU time this request consumes. Charging it bills the same GPU-seconds once per request queued behind them: with k requests of u tokens in flight the queue charge grows as u^2 k^2 / 2 while the real work grows linearly. On the planner side the same term is CORRECT, because there it prices the delay a candidate IMPOSES on others, which is exactly what it measures
P2_budget_vs_gpu_busy.intercept_is_not_the_driver: charging the 0.0678 s intercept to every request makes a 1-frame dashcam append 2.0x dearer and a 21-frame one 1.1x dearer, which alone would not starve anything
P2_budget_vs_gpu_busy.utilisation_finding: the PER-UNCACHED term tracks measured GPU busy time to 2 percent, and its implied rate 5,482 tok/s agrees with the committed 5,600 tok/s prefill rate to 2 percent. The INTERCEPT tracks nothing: it adds 46 percent (s4) and 51 percent (s5) of the wall clock and takes work-only utilisation to 1.07 and 1.34 of wall while the GPU is 60 to 80 percent busy. A budget cannot be more than fully subscribed by requests the engine had time for, so work-only FAILS the utilisation half of D102 on measured data even though it passes the no-artificial-binding half on a dry cell
P2_budget_vs_gpu_busy.gate: refusals at or below 500, plan_state still reaching decisions, and the decision log within 10 percent of covex-v6-rules' 4376 rows
P2_budget_vs_gpu_busy.verdict: FAIL: work-only passes the dry no-binding half (288 refusals, 2038 state decisions, 4318 rows) but FAILS the utilisation half: it oversubscribes the wall clock on ['covex-v6-state s4', 'covex-v6-state s5'] while the GPU is 60 to 80 percent busy, because of the 0.0678 s per-request INTERCEPT. The per-uncached term alone tracks measured busy time to 2 percent. NO ARM IS ENABLED and no rerun is posted
